purpose: Permanent fail-closed CI boundary that prevents R6 PAPER execution surfaces from acquiring LIVE endpoint authority, unaudited network/write authority, AI/research authorization, or PAPER-to-LIVE promotion semantics.
controls: Scans every production alpaca_paper_* module, not only known network files.
Only explicit LIVE deny constants may contain LIVE Trading API/WSS authority literals.
LIVE deny constants may only be read inside comparisons; using them to construct URLs or authority fails CI.
HTTP gateway/reconciliation/writer roles each have an exact one-Request and one-low-level-open I/O budget with literal GET/GET/POST methods.
Exactly one self._transport.write(request) is permitted and only in the audited writer.
trade_updates has exactly one websocket_connect, one connector.open and two socket.send control frames.
OpenAI, Anthropic and autotrade.research imports are forbidden in all R6 external execution modules.
New identifiers containing live are forbidden except the two explicit deny constants, preventing PAPER-to-LIVE promotion surfaces.
Required Safety/OMS final-write guard and exact PAPER host/path anchors are checked statically.
The boundary is wired into both Core Safety and R6 Authority workflows with adversarial tests.
non_claims: This boundary does not qualify external PAPER execution.
This boundary does not prove profitability.
This boundary does not authorize LIVE trading.
next_gate: Run full Core Safety, Knowledge Contract and R6 Authority on the exact implementation SHA; only then may TD-R6-008 close.
